info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Creditcard Applications Decline-v1-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows authorized users to decline specific credit card applications. By targeting applications with a decline status, financial institutions can manage and streamline the approval process efficiently. Typical consumers of this API include banking personnel and system integrators who require automation in their application processing workflows. The operation ensures that declined applications are properly handled within the system, maintaining accurate records of application statuses.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to decline an application, indicating that it will not be processed further. This is useful for managing application workflows and responding to applicants.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to decline an application. It should include the necessary data to identify the application to be declined.

200.description: The application has been successfully declined.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineReque.description: A string representation of the decline request body for an application operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the decline operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the operation reference.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the decline request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the decline operation.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineRespo.description: Response schema for the DELETE operation on applications decline.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the decline record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the decline record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the decline operation was performed automatically.

Audit.description: Information regarding the audit trail of the decline operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
